zh.title: Agent 在云端，为什么还能操作我的电脑？
zh.lead: 拆开推理计算、持久状态和执行环境，再模拟设备离线与 Loop 重启。
zh.diagramLabel: 计算、状态、环境三者的位置与可用性
zh.cloud: Loop 与状态上云，重建环境
zh.restartLoop: 模拟重启 Loop 进程
zh.daemon: 个人设备上的轻量 daemon
zh.loopPaused: ■ 设备离线，Loop 也无法继续
zh.loopRecovered: ↳ 新 Loop 读取持久状态继续协调
zh.stateSaved: ✓ Session / Ticket 记录仍保留；运行中进程不等于持久状态
zh.localWork: ▶ 可访问本机未提交变更与工具链
zh.offlineWork: … 等设备恢复；不能执行本机命令
zh.cloudWork: ◇ 环境需要复制或重建；未提交变更、内网和设备依赖可能缺失
zh.byomWork: → daemon 在原环境执行命令并返回结果；不承担 Session 状态
zh.wait: 等待设备不等于整个云端 Agent 停止；与该设备无关的协调仍可继续。
zh.localHint: 教学前提：本地 Session 已写入磁盘。设备离线不会自动删除它，但本机 Loop 不能继续。
zh.cloudHint: 云端副本能运行，不代表它与用户当前环境一致。
zh.caption: 外置持久状态允许替换 Loop；连接执行设备允许环境留在原处。两层解耦解决不同问题。
zh.limit0: 三者分离和自动等待设备重连是文章目标架构；本页不声称公开原型已经实现完整 BYOM。
zh.limit1: 云端 Loop 与执行设备互信会扩大安全边界；持久化不是权限隔离，也不是备份或高可用保证。
zh.limit2: Loop 重启后进程内 jobs 不会复活；图中的“继续”表示重建执行，而非恢复旧 shell 进程。
zh.question: 把 Session 存进数据库，就已经实现 BYOM 了吗？
zh.answer: 没有。还需要执行环境接口、端点连接、离线调度和权限管理；状态持久化只解决其中一个生命周期问题。
zh.step0Explanation: Loop 运行、记录持久化、工具环境可用性是独立问题。切换部署结构观察它们的位置。
zh.step1Explanation: 登录问题可能依赖未提交变更、私有服务或硬件；复制仓库不等于复制整个环境。
zh.step2Title: 设备离线时谁还在工作？
zh.step2Explanation: 切换在线开关。云端推理可以继续协调，但需要该设备的命令仍必须等待。
zh.step3Title: 替换 Loop，重新读取状态
zh.step3Explanation: 重启计算与恢复记录不同于恢复正在运行的命令。只有持久化的信息能够重新读取。

en.title: How can a cloud agent work on my computer?
en.lead: Separate inference compute, durable state, and execution environments, then simulate device disconnection and a Loop restart.
en.diagramLabel: Placement and availability of compute, state, and environments
en.cloud: Cloud Loop and state, rebuilt environment
en.daemon: Lightweight daemon on the personal device
en.loopPaused: ■ Device offline; its Loop cannot continue
en.loopRecovered: ↳ Replacement Loop reads durable state to continue coordination
en.stateSaved: ✓ Session / Ticket records retained; live processes are separate from durable state
en.localWork: ▶ Can access uncommitted changes and the local toolchain
en.offlineWork: … Wait for reconnection; local commands cannot run
en.cloudWork: ◇ Environment must be copied or rebuilt; local changes, intranet access, or device dependencies may be missing
en.byomWork: → Daemon executes in the original environment and returns results; session state stays elsewhere
en.wait: Waiting for one device need not stop the cloud agent; unrelated coordination can continue.
en.localHint: Teaching assumption: local sessions are persisted to disk. Disconnection does not delete them, but the local Loop cannot continue.
en.cloudHint: A running cloud copy need not match the user’s current environment.
en.caption: External durable state allows Loop replacement. Device connections keep environments in place. These solve different problems.
en.limit0: The separation and automatic reconnection behavior are architectural goals. This page does not claim a complete public BYOM implementation.
en.limit1: Trust between cloud Loops and devices expands the security boundary. Persistence alone is neither permission isolation nor a backup or availability guarantee.
en.limit2: In-process jobs do not revive after Loop restart. Continuing means recreating execution, not reviving an old shell process.
en.question: Does storing sessions in a database implement BYOM?
en.answer: No. Environment interfaces, endpoint connections, offline scheduling, and permissions are additional work. Persistence solves only one lifecycle problem.
en.step0Explanation: Loop execution, durable records, and environment availability are separate concerns. Switch designs to inspect placement.
en.step1Explanation: A login issue can depend on uncommitted work, private services, or hardware. Copying a repository does not copy the entire environment.
en.step2Title: What keeps working when a device disconnects?
en.step2Explanation: Toggle device availability. Cloud inference can coordinate while commands requiring that device must wait.
en.step3Title: Replace the Loop and reload state
en.step3Explanation: Restarting compute and loading records does not restore live commands. Only persisted information can be reloaded.
en.connections: Loop → read/write durable state · Loop → request tool execution → return environment results
